sections.title: <is-date-range-picker>
sections.lede: Rango de fechas con varios meses a la vista y panel de atajos (DateRangeCalendar de MUI X). El hover en un mes pinta la banda tentativa en todos.

blocks.html:
<is-date-range-picker
            id="rp"
            locale="es"
            calendars="2"
            shortcuts="this-week last-week last-7-days current-month next-month reset"
          ></is-date-range-picker>

<is-date-range-picker locale="es" calendars="2" shortcuts="none">
            <is-button slot="shortcut" variant="outlined" pill data-range="2026-07-01/2026-07-15">Primera quincena</is-button>
            <is-button slot="shortcut" variant="outlined" pill data-range="2026-07-16/2026-07-31">Segunda quincena</is-button>
            <is-button slot="shortcut" variant="outlined" color="neutral" pill data-preset="reset">Limpiar</is-button>
          </is-date-range-picker>
